title: SPPU slashes ILS Law College "other fees" for 2022-25 by around 90%
description: Savitribai Phule Pune University (SPPU) has fixed ILS Law College's "other fees" for academic sessions 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 at ₹2,714 ₹4,031 and ₹3,342 respectively.All 3 figures are about 90% below the roughly ₹37,000 the College has been charging under this head in recent years.The amounts were recommended by SPPU's Fee Fixation Committee (FFC) and approved by the Vice-Chancellor (VC) on behalf of the Academic Council.
